scenes.basis: 14:1 "In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews"
14:6-7 "and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region. There they preached the Good News" - the following scene is at Lystra (14:8)
14:8 "At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet" - the healing, the sacrifice and the stoning are at Lystra
14:20-21 "On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe. When they had preached the Good News to that city"
14:21 "they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch"; 14:22 "confirming the souls of the disciples" - a return through three cities with no single setting
14:25 "When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia"
14:26 "From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God"; 14:27 "When they had arrived, and had gathered the assembly together"
